program.section_heading: Social Justice: LGBTQ Studies - Associate in Arts for Transfer (ADT) - AA1080 (CalGETC)
outcomes: Utilize queer and transgender theory along with feminist theory to explore and analyze conceptions of power and oppression.
Employ the principles of Queer and Transgender Studies to identify, explore, and analyze examples of prejudice, discrimination, or oppression in historical or cultural frameworks.
Examine the process of gender socialization and critique gender binaries.
Analyze queer and transgender experiences and gender/sexuality politics across cultures.
Engage critical thinking and communication skills with a focus on cultural and global awareness.
Use statistics or research methods in the behavioral and social sciences to better analyze issues related to Queer and Transgender Studies.
Analyze issues across multiple disciplines through the lens of gender and sexuality.

notes: The 'Required Courses' heading prints Units: 9.00, but the courses listed under it (ETS-1 at 3 units plus one 3-unit course from the 'Select one of the following' list) total 6 units; the stated 9 is recorded on the Required Courses block as printed. With 9-10 elective units the printed program total of 18-19 also implies 9 required units. Reviewer should check whether a required course is missing from the text.

Elective Courses: 'Choose three courses from at least two areas.' Area 1 – History or Government: HIST-34, HIST-38. Area 2 - Arts and Humanities: ETS-7, ETS-8, ETS-13/PHI-14. Area 3 - Social Science: BIO-16, COMM-13, ETS-40, PSYC-11, SOC-21. Area 4 - Quantitative Reasoning and Research Methods: STAT-C1000, STAT-C1000H, PSYC-48, SOC-48. The at-least-two-areas constraint is not captured by the block rule.

ETS-13 and PHI-14 are printed under 'Only one may be used', so they are recorded as alternatives of a single choice. STAT-C1000, STAT-C1000H, PSYC-48 and SOC-48 are also printed under 'Only one may be used' and are recorded as alternatives of a single choice.

The catalog prints HIST-34 and HIST-38, while the closed list has HIS 34 and HIS 38 with the same numbers and titles. They are treated as the same courses (catalog_addition false). Reviewer should confirm the subject prefix.
SOC-48 (Statistics for the Behavioral Sciences) is not in the closed list and is marked catalog_addition true.
Closed-list PSYC48 is matched to the printed PSYC-48.
